exposure: Maternal lamivudine (LAM) treatment in the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 45 HBsAg-positive pregnant women eligible for lamivudine treatment who registered for antenatal care between 2007 and 2012.
finding: Maternal lamivudine therapy in highly viraemic HBV-infected pregnant women significantly reduced viral load at delivery and was associated with no cases of perinatal transmission in infants born to treated mothers.
